key_insight: A mixture-of-experts framework with generative diffusion models can learn scenario-specific physical-layer security policies and generalize them across unseen wireless environments.
engineering_relevance: This enables 6G systems to deliver robust secrecy-rate optimization without repeatedly re-solving security beamforming from scratch for every new deployment scenario.
method: Select representative wireless scenarios and train scenario-specific generative diffusion experts for secure beamforming with artificial noise.
Use a lightweight gating network to infer scenario-relevant channel features and choose the top experts.
Fuse expert outputs with an attention-based combiner to produce a high-fidelity security strategy for unseen scenarios.
evidence_signal: Simulations show the framework can recognize scenarios, select experts appropriately, and maintain near-optimal secrecy rates across a continuum of wireless settings while outperforming single-model baselines.
watch_item: Performance depends on the representativeness of chosen scenarios and the reliability of gating on real channel measurements, which may be challenging under distribution shift.
paper_title: Unlocking Cross-Scenario Physical Layer Security: A Mixture-of-Experts Framework with Generative Diffusion Models
